newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS names Gray head of Swiss asset mgt.
newsitem.headline: UBS names Gray head of Swiss asset mgt.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) has appointed Roger Gray head of UBS Asset Management Switzerland, a bank spokesman said on Friday.
Gray, 39, succeeds Bernd Borgmeier, who has left the company.

Formerly head of N.M. Rothschild's institutional asset management business in London, Gray will have responsibility for the UBS institutional and wholesale money management activities based in Zurich. He manages a staff of 135 people. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
